mechanistic_claim_tested: Radial-ray predominance of FA limb malformations
key_finding: 28/28 limb-affected FA patients had thumb hypoplasia; radial dysplasia and thumb duplication common; screen for FA in all radial-ray anomalies
confidence_and_limitations: Descriptive, no inferential stats; establishes explanandum but does not test mechanism

mechanistic_claim_tested: p53/p21 hyperactivation eliminates FA progenitors
key_finding: p53 hyperactivated on replicative stress -> p21-dependent G0/G1 arrest depletes HSPCs; p53 knockdown rescues defect
confidence_and_limitations: Strong mechanistic evidence but hematopoietic; limb-bud step not tested (extrapolation)

mechanistic_claim_tested: FA as p53-p21 senescence syndrome driving developmental abnormality
key_finding: FA cells show p53-p21 axis activation; senescence can drive developmental abnormalities
confidence_and_limitations: Review-level synthesis; orientation not primary limb evidence

mechanistic_claim_tested: Endogenous aldehydes + FA loss cause developmental defects
key_finding: Aldh2 essential for development of Fancd2-/- embryos; in-utero ethanol sensitivity; abnormal development
confidence_and_limitations: Developmental defects not specifically radial-ray; strong causal aldehyde link

mechanistic_claim_tested: Aldehyde + FA loss catastrophically depletes progenitors
key_finding: >600-fold reduction in HSC pool in Aldh2-/-Fancd2-/- mice; only HSPCs need Aldh2 protection
confidence_and_limitations: Hematopoietic not limb; demonstrates progenitor-specific vulnerability principle

mechanistic_claim_tested: Aldehyde stress drives p53-dependent progenitor loss
key_finding: Endogenous formaldehyde requires ALDH2/ADH5 + FA pathway; ages HSCs in a p53-driven manner
confidence_and_limitations: Unifies aldehyde + p53 arms; hematopoietic context

mechanistic_claim_tested: Aldehyde-detox loss impairs human progenitor expansion
key_finding: ADH5/ALDH2-deficient iPSC show drastically defective expansion on hematopoietic differentiation
confidence_and_limitations: In vitro hematopoietic differentiation; no limb model

mechanistic_claim_tested: Malformation burden scales with FA-pathway depth
key_finding: ID-complex genotypes associated with VACTERL-H (limb); upstream-complex lack VACTERL-H
confidence_and_limitations: Consistent with dose-dependent progenitor loss; does not localize to anterior field

mechanistic_claim_tested: SHH patterning underlies radial-ray anomalies
key_finding: SHH expression associated with induction of both RLD and radial polydactyly in animal studies
confidence_and_limitations: Supports patterning alternative; SHH is posterior morphogen — anterior effect indirect

mechanistic_claim_tested: Radius and thumb deficiency severity co-vary
key_finding: Radial and thumb severity correlated (Kendall tau=0.49, 95% CI 0.40-0.57, p<0.05); syndromic 2x more bilateral
confidence_and_limitations: Consistent with a shared anterior field effect (either mechanism)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Posterior-to-anterior gradient of polarizing activity in limb
key_finding: Anterior radius has weaker/later polarizing (Shh/Ihh) activity than posterior ulna
confidence_and_limitations: Background on A-P asymmetry; not FA-specific

mechanistic_claim_tested: FANCA can present with ectrodactyly not classic radial ray
key_finding: FANCA family with ectrodactyly; modifier EHMT1 variant co-segregated
confidence_and_limitations: Shows limb phenotype heterogeneity beyond radial ray; modifier effects

mechanistic_claim_tested: RAD51-FA strongly associated with VACTERL limb anomalies
key_finding: De novo RAD51 variant with VACTERL + PHENOS including limb anomalies
confidence_and_limitations: Reinforces genotype-limb association; single case

mechanistic_claim_tested: TBX5 patterning mechanism for preaxial radial ray
key_finding: Holt-Oram = preaxial radial ray + cardiac via TBX5 haploinsufficiency (transcription factor)
confidence_and_limitations: Patterning route, not apoptosis; parallel radial-ray convergence

mechanistic_claim_tested: TBX5 haploinsufficiency causes radial ray
key_finding: TBX5 mutations cause anterior/radial ray upper-limb malformations + cardiac
confidence_and_limitations: Patterning-gene mechanism competing with progenitor apoptosis

mechanistic_claim_tested: SALL4 transcription factor radial ray
key_finding: SALL4 nonsense mutation causes Duane-radial-ray; radial ray defects + absent thumbs
confidence_and_limitations: TF/patterning mechanism; thumb involvement like FA but via transcription

mechanistic_claim_tested: RBM8A drives radial ray via Hedgehog/bone development
key_finding: RBM8A critical for embryonic bone development and proper Hedgehog signaling (title-level claim; abstract truncated in tool)
confidence_and_limitations: Patterning/Hedgehog route; snippet from title not abstract (unvalidated)

mechanistic_claim_tested: RBM8A radial ray via LPM Wnt/PCP patterning
key_finding: rbm8a perturbation impairs lateral-plate-mesoderm architecture via non-canonical Wnt/PCP; forelimb+hematopoietic progenitors affected
confidence_and_limitations: Patterning/mesoderm-architecture mechanism, not apoptosis

mechanistic_claim_tested: TAR obligately preserves thumb (clinical rule)
key_finding: TAR = bilateral radial aplasia with preserved thumbs (clinical/diagnostic rule)
confidence_and_limitations: Discriminator is penetrance/obligate-presence; NOT supported at HPO annotation level (see Monarch query row)

mechanistic_claim_tested: FA annotated limb phenotype = radial-ray field
key_finding: Monarch/HPO D->P query: FA (668 assoc) annotated with radius + 1st metacarpal + thumb terms incl HP:0006433 Radial ray deficiency; spans reduction AND duplication
confidence_and_limitations: Ontology-annotation check not mechanism; counts=curation depth not frequency; verified 2026-09-13 (artifact monarch_hpo_query.json)

mechanistic_claim_tested: TAR thumb-sparing NOT clean at annotation level
key_finding: Monarch query: TAR (115 assoc) carries thumb annotations (Absent/Short/Broad/Adducted thumb); Holt-Oram (132) extensive thumb+radius set
confidence_and_limitations: Corrects prior thumb-sparing discriminator; overlap across all three disorders; verified 2026-09-13

mechanistic_claim_tested: Radius selectively lost via reduced proliferation not apoptosis
key_finding: FGFR inhibition in chick wing -> absence of radius but not ulna; NOT via massive apoptosis, via reduced proliferation/adhesion of chondroprogenitors
confidence_and_limitations: Supports proliferation-demand premise; qualifies apoptosis effector toward arrest
